name: music-reel
description: Turn a song into a beat-synced vertical lyric reel with HyperFrames.

interface.shortDescription: Song in, beat-synced lyric reel out.
interface.longDescription: Measure a song's beats (and optionally its sung words), drive a HyperFrames reel template from that timing, and render a vertical MP4. Starts with a bundled no-key sample.
defaultPrompt: Make a beat-synced reel for my song.
Turn songs/my-song into a lyric reel.
